Matthew Ehret joins host Danny Jones for a long podcast talk titled around a stark claim: powerful forces want to replace God. The title links that claim to Satan, UFOs, and secret societies. Ehret is the guest, and Jones guides the talk as host.

Ehret lays out his view that a hidden spiritual war sits behind world events and world power. The talk moves between faith, hidden groups, and strange events in the sky. Listeners who follow claims of a secret order behind history will find the guest's full case here, stated plainly and at length. The library keeps the episode as an archive record, without taking a side.
